About the job
Auwald builds planning software for manufacturing companies and grew to 22 million euros in annual recurring revenue. We need an Interim CMO to rebuild our marketing engine before a new funding round.

What you will do
• Lead the marketing team of nine (demand generation, product marketing, content, marketing operations)
• Own pipeline targets together with sales and build an account-based marketing programme for 300 target accounts
• Rework our HubSpot set-up, lead scoring and attribution
• Sharpen positioning and messaging for two new product lines
• Report marketing performance to the board

What you bring
• 10+ years in B2B marketing, at least 4 in a leadership role
• Proven demand generation and ABM experience in SaaS or technology
• Strong HubSpot and marketing operations know-how
• Fluent English and German

Terms
• 6 months, start November 2026
• Two days a week in Munich
• €1,400 per day
